notes.title: Demo is Up + Discord
notes.notes:
[p][b]Hey everyone![/b][/p][p]I'm excited to announce that the demo for [b]Awrak[/b] has just been released! 
I've also set up a [b]Discord server[/b] where you can chat about the game, share your thoughts, and report any feedback or suggestions.[/p][p][/p][p][b]You can try the demo here:[/b][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3753830/Awrak_Demo/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][b]Join the Discord community: [/b][/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/Uy83FuCGFa"]https://discord.gg/Uy83FuCGFa[/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]Looking forward to hearing what you think![/p]
